scores.tell: Purple cauldron on lilac floor with pink wall: monochrome purple mass, very loud neon-green goo; background is pastel but whole card is cool-pink-purple, less natural local color than real cards.
Pastel pink/lavender sky and tiled floor wash over everything; blue binoculars blend with cool haze, low neutral rest and hue-tinted atmospheric cast unlike real flat color fields.
Natural greens, blue sky, lilac-gray stone; grass and hero similar chroma but close to the real swing card. Slightly minty/over-uniform green.
Hot magenta background with purple floor and saturated orange visor; background is as loud as the hero and the white helmet picks up pink/purple tints.
Orange-red diamond background and orange floor compete with green backpack and blue roll; too many fully saturated hues, background as loud as hero.
Blue door vs orange frame and cream wall, natural ivy greens; good neutral rest. Minor tell: pastel flowers/bow add extra accents.
Red keyboard on saturated blue starburst with gray stand; matches real card color logic (hero vs complementary ground). Slight tell: rainbow buttons add extra hues.
Red cooler, cyan sea, orange sand with cream neutrals; believable colors and rest from white. Tell: three saturated cans plus sand warmth add many hue families.
Magenta/purple background with gold and blue drums and red stage: very loud, many saturated families, little neutral rest; hero and background equally chromatic.
